scope: Frozen unlabeled open-loop software baseline, not perception accuracy or production acceptance.

code.worktree: Uncommitted module; exact source hashes are in the detailed report.

dataset.temporal_subset: First 60 consecutive frames, fixed before evaluating outputs.

limitations: Expanded engine is not numerically equivalent to original 10000-pillar engine.
Detector intensity normalization and ground reference z=0 remain diagnostic assumptions.
Relative recorded localization is diagnostic-only, not a verified continuous ODOM source.
Compensated per-ray origins and vehicle capabilities are not established; FREE disabled.
Thresholds and models were not tuned after observing evaluation results.

full_record_single_frame.count_unit: Object/unknown frame outputs, not unique ground-truth objects.

continuous_60_frame_comparison.configuration: Same enhanced candidates for all three variants; only temporal state and deliberate detector availability differ.

injected_frames_only.interpretation: Only partial instance preservation; these counts are not recall.

candidate_ablation_on_same_60_frames.interpretation: More candidate fragments, not demonstrated accuracy or false-positive improvement.

diagnostic_visibility.interpretation: Every ray stops at an unknown-risk-obstructed origin cell. Meaningful real-record visibility was not achieved; FREE=0 is not a free-space success.

observed_offline_time_ms.conditions: One run, dev/fastbuild, first inference included, init/serialization/queue excluded. Full and temporal replay workers overlap on a shared i7-12700KF/RTX4060 host. Not controlled throughput or optimization evidence.
observed_offline_time_ms.interpretation: The CPU reference is far above the 5-10ms design target in this run; no performance optimization was applied.

not_evaluable_without_ground_truth: AP, detection/unknown recall and precision, false-positive or duplicate rate.
MOTA, IDF1, identity switches or physical velocity error.
FREE precision, vehicle traversability, braking or closed-loop safety.
key_findings: 6685 of 10039 normal object-frame outputs carry class conflict; model agreement is weak, not evidence of improved accuracy.
Enhanced candidates increase unknown outputs from 6318 to 10530 on identical 60 frames; fragmentation needs labeled review.
Intentional detector dropout preserves only 46 versus 153 normal object-frame outputs, despite recovery triggering on all 15 frames.
Visibility degenerates at the sensor origin on every frame; no useful drivable-area result is established.
